## Architecture Overview

Kubernetes client-go `tools/cache` has introduced `TransactionStore` (in `store.go`) with a `Transaction(txns ...Transaction) *TransactionError` method, and `QueueWithBatch` (in `fifo.go`) with `PopBatch()`. `the_real_fifo.go` implements `QueueWithBatch` as `RealFIFO`, and `ThreadSafeStoreWithTransaction` in `thread_safe_store.go` implements `TransactionStore`. These extend the existing `cache.Store`, `cache.Queue`, and `cache.SharedInformer` interfaces used by virtually every Kubernetes controller.

## Detailed Analysis

### Kubernetes Core Definitions

- **`staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/store.go`** — `TransactionStore` interface (lines 92-109), `cache` struct `Transaction()` method (lines 207-239).
- **`staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/thread_safe_store.go`** — `ThreadSafeStoreWithTransaction` interface (lines 63-68), `threadSafeMap.Transaction()` (lines 247-265).
- **`staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/the_real_fifo.go`** — `RealFIFO` implementing `QueueWithBatch` (line 65), `PopBatch()` (lines 390-478).
- **`staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/cache/fifo.go`** — `QueueWithBatch` interface definition (lines 65-86).

### ArgoCD

- **`controller/cache/cache.go`** — Uses `cache.SharedIndexInformer` for Application watching, `SetBatchEventsProcessing()` configuration.
- **`util/settings/cluster_informer.go`** — Wraps `cache.SharedIndexInformer` for cluster config watching.
- **`util/settings/settings.go`** — `secretsInformer cache.SharedIndexInformer` field.

### Cert-Manager

- **`internal/informers/core.go`** — Custom `Informer` interface wrapping subset of `SharedIndexInformer` (lines 70-77).
- **`internal/informers/core_basic.go`** — Custom filtered informer implementations.

### Istio

- **`pkg/config/schema/kubeclient/common.go`** — `cache.NewSharedIndexInformer()` and `cache.NewSharedIndexInformerWithOptions()`.
- **`pkg/kube/krt/informer.go`** — Custom informer collection wrapper (lines 33-44).
- **`pkg/kube/kclient/client.go`** — Client-side cache management with SharedIndexInformer.

### Cilium

- **`pkg/k8s/informer/informer.go`** — `NewInformer()` returns `cache.Store` and `cache.Controller` (lines 50-61), `NewInformerWithStore()` creates `cache.NewDeltaFIFOWithOptions()` (lines 65-136), processes `cache.Deltas`.
- **`pkg/k8s/resource/store.go`** — Wraps cache.Store for resource tracking.

### OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib

- **`receiver/k8sclusterreceiver/internal/testutils/mock_cache_store.go`** — Test implementation of `cache.Store` (lines 12-24).
- **`processor/k8sattributesprocessor/internal/kube/client.go`** — Multiple `cache.SharedInformer` fields (lines 68-79) for pods, namespaces, nodes, deployments, etc.
